description: Defines data models for categories and products in an online shopping platform, including simple data classes and a formatting method for product prices.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Simple catalog category model with id and name.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Product model including id, name, categoryId, price in cents, description, and a method to format the price as a dollar string.

methods.name: formattedPrice
methods.description: Returns the product price formatted as a dollar amount string.
